title: PCG conducts aerial search for 8 missing MV June Aster passengers

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY— The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) conducted an aerial survey over the waters off Palawan, extending to Bantac Island, as search and response operations continued on Tuesday (Sept. 22) for eight people still missing following the fire that gutted passenger vessel MV June Aster off Coron town two weeks ago, according to Commodore Noemie Cayabyab, PCG spokesperson.
